request: Build a small headless Jac document-intake backend for an eldercare assistant. A Patient graph node is the hub, and incoming Document nodes hang off it. Define Patient in graph/nodes/patient.jac and Document in graph/nodes/document.jac. Put the AI abilities in abilities/llm_abilities.jac: a module-level model named llm plus two LLM-backed functions, classify_document (returns one document category name such as EOB, MEDICAL_BILL or WILL) and translate_to_plain_english (returns a plain-English summary for an elderly reader). Add two walkers that start at a Patient and visit its documents: DocumentClassify in graph/walkers/intake/document_classify.jac stores the category on documents still marked UNKNOWN, and PlainEnglishTranslator in graph/walkers/intake/plain_english_translator.jac stores a summary on documents that have content but no summary yet. Either walker stops its whole walk at the first document it should skip. A thin main.jac imports everything. Include tests that replace the model with MockLLM.
acceptance: Spawning DocumentClassify on a Patient sets each connected UNKNOWN Document's classification to the model's returned category, in connection order.
DocumentClassify stops the whole walk at the first Document whose classification is not UNKNOWN, leaving later documents UNKNOWN and making no model call.
Spawning PlainEnglishTranslator on a Patient stores the model's returned text in plain_english_summary of a Document that has raw_content and no summary.
PlainEnglishTranslator stops the whole walk at the first Document with empty raw_content or an existing summary, leaving later documents unsummarised.
Running DocumentClassify then PlainEnglishTranslator on the same Patient fills both classification and plain_english_summary from two consecutive model outputs.
constraints: Use Jac 0.36.1 and a backend-only service; no JSX or browser UI; never call a real model (test any by llm function with MockLLM).

Keep these exact public names and paths: node Patient (graph/nodes/patient.jac), node Document (graph/nodes/document.jac), glob llm and functions classify_document and translate_to_plain_english (abilities/llm_abilities.jac), walker DocumentClassify (graph/walkers/intake/document_classify.jac), walker PlainEnglishTranslator (graph/walkers/intake/plain_english_translator.jac).
Tests swap the model by assigning abilities.llm_abilities.llm = MockLLM(...) from jaclang.byllm.lib; the abilities module must read its model from that module-level glob llm at call time.
